title: Fever
what_it_is: A temporary rise in body temperature, often as the body's natural response to fighting an infection.
common_symptoms: Body temperature above the usual range
general_info: Fever itself is usually a sign that the body's immune system is responding to something, such as a viral or bacterial infection, rather than a condition on its own.
when_to_seek_care: Seek medical care for a very high or persistent fever, a fever lasting more than a few days, a fever in an infant, or if it's accompanied by severe symptoms like difficulty breathing, confusion, stiff neck, or a rash.

title: Headache
what_it_is: Pain or discomfort in the head or upper neck region, with many possible causes ranging from tension to underlying conditions.
common_symptoms: Pain on one or both sides
general_info: Most headaches are tension-type or related to factors like dehydration, poor sleep, or stress, but some patterns can point to conditions like migraine.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care urgently for a sudden 'worst headache of your life,' a headache with fever and stiff neck, confusion, vision changes, weakness, or a headache following a head injury.

title: Cough
what_it_is: A reflex that helps clear the airway of irritants, mucus, or foreign particles.
general_info: Coughs are commonly linked to colds, allergies, or irritants, though a persistent cough can have other causes.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for a cough lasting more than a few weeks, a cough with blood, high fever, unexplained weight loss, or significant difficulty breathing.

title: Sore Throat
what_it_is: Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat, often worsened by swallowing.
general_info: Sore throats are frequently caused by viral infections such as the common cold, though bacterial infections like strep throat are also possible.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for a severe sore throat, difficulty swallowing or breathing, a high fever, or a sore throat lasting more than a week.

title: Stomach Pain
what_it_is: Discomfort or pain felt anywhere between the chest and pelvic region, with many possible causes.
general_info: Stomach pain can range from mild, self-limiting issues like indigestion to conditions that need prompt attention, depending on location, severity, and associated symptoms.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care urgently for severe or sudden abdominal pain, pain with a rigid abdomen, persistent vomiting, blood in stool or vomit, or pain following an injury.

title: Dehydration
what_it_is: A condition where the body loses more fluids than it takes in, affecting normal bodily functions.
general_info: Mild dehydration is common and usually improves with fluids, but it can become serious, especially in children, older adults, and during illness with vomiting or diarrhea.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for signs of severe dehydration such as confusion, rapid heartbeat, very little or no urination, or inability to keep fluids down.

title: Common Cold
what_it_is: A mild viral infection of the nose and throat, one of the most frequent illnesses.
general_info: Colds are generally self-limiting and improve within a week to ten days with rest and fluids.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care if symptoms worsen after a week, if there's high fever, significant difficulty breathing, or symptoms that don't improve as expected.

title: Migraine
what_it_is: A neurological condition causing intense, often throbbing headaches, sometimes with additional symptoms.
common_symptoms: Throbbing pain, often on one side
general_info: Migraines can be triggered by factors like stress, certain foods, hormonal changes, or sleep disruption, and patterns vary a lot between individuals.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care for a first-time severe migraine-like headache, a sudden change in your usual migraine pattern, or if accompanied by weakness, confusion, or vision loss.

title: Allergies
what_it_is: An immune system reaction to a substance (allergen) that is normally harmless.
common_symptoms: In severe cases, swelling or difficulty breathing
general_info: Allergic reactions range from mild seasonal symptoms to more significant reactions depending on the allergen and individual sensitivity.
when_to_seek_care: Seek emergency care immediately for signs of a severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) such as difficulty breathing, throat swelling, or widespread hives with dizziness.

title: Back Pain
what_it_is: Discomfort or pain in the back, commonly in the lower back, affecting most people at some point.
common_symptoms: Pain that may radiate to the legs
general_info: Back pain is often related to muscle strain or posture, and most cases improve with time, gentle movement, and self-care.
when_to_seek_care: Seek care urgently for back pain with numbness or weakness in the legs, loss of bladder or bowel control, or pain following a significant injury.
